syntax.title: Search syntax
syntax.intro: Type words to search card names, and add filters to narrow the results. Everything you write must match, unless you say otherwise.
syntax.basic.1: Cards whose name contains both words.
syntax.basic.3: An exclamation mark asks for the exact name.
syntax.basic.4: Filters are written key:value, and all of them must match.
syntax.operators: Number filters accept : = != < <= > >=, as in mv<=3 or pow>=5.

import.intro: Bring in a collection from a file. You will see what was understood before anything is written.

import.error.unknown_format: This file is not in a format the import understands.
import.error.no_catalog: The card catalog has not been downloaded yet.

export.csv_hint: One row per entry, with card name, set and number spelled out. Opens in any spreadsheet.
export.json_hint: The complete dump: every entry and every location, also the empty ones, with their notes and order.

admin.title: Administration
admin.started: Started. This page reloads by itself while it runs.
admin.backups.where: Saved in {folder}. Every night: a copy of the database and a CSV. Kept: every one of the last 7 days, one per week for 4 weeks, one per month for a year.
admin.settings.schedule_on: Catalog update at {update}:00, backup at {backup}:00, every day. If the computer was off, they run when it is back on.
lock.notice: The collection is locked, so nothing can change it by accident. Unlock it to add, edit, move, remove or import cards.
